title: feat(dek1): deep-enter same-k holds at k=1: t=3 vs t=5
science: Defines deep-enter delta-eps and, in the prose, explains why a naive definition is unusable: on a nearest-neighbour 2->3 hop the destination always carries a newly created unit coordinate, so min over ALL dest coordinates would always be 1 and the clause would be vacuous; the min must be taken over coordinates already nonzero at the source. That modelling lemma is the member's real content. B_6: 3
